scenes.narration: A free Mac battery meter that shows more.
A real reading: percent, an arrow, and watts.
A sample. The arrow points down while it drains.
Another sample. Orange at 20 percent or below.
The menu adds time left, volts, adapter, and cycles.
Hide Apple's icon, then hold Command and drag BatteryMeter in.
Free for Apple silicon Macs. No email, no account.
